hook.text: Before eBay, auctions required physical presence. Pierre Omidyar changed that with a website in 1995.

buildup.text: eBay created a global auction house where anyone could sell anything to anyone, 24/7.

discovery.text: Proxy bidding let users set a maximum. The system bid incrementally on their behalf, automating strategy.

twist.text: Despite the auction format, eBay shifted toward fixed-price listings. By 2020, most sales used 'Buy It Now.'

climax.text: eBay proved that trust systems—ratings, reviews, escrow—could replace the handshake in online trade.

punchline.text: eBay auctioned the idea of online trust.

quiz.question: What did eBay's proxy bidding system automate?
options: Incremental bidding up to a user's maximum
